title: Error-budget delegation and contingency matrix for initiative owners
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a clear delegation model and contingency matrix so initiative owners can operate within allocated error budgets. The output will be a lightweight playbook, an on-call decision matrix, dashboard views per initiative, and automated alerts that map to recommended mitigations and rollback criteria.
background: We currently centralize error-budget decisions with reliability leads which slows down rollout velocity for multiple feature teams. Teams lack clear guardrails for when to throttle experiments, roll back changes, or request expanded capacity. This ticket defines delegation thresholds, severity-to-action mappings, and integration points with the initiative tracker and incident tooling.
goals: Define delegation thresholds for initiative owners (minor/major breaches)
Publish a contingency matrix mapping SLI deviations to concrete actions and owners
Create initiative-scoped dashboard templates with run rate and burn forecasts
Automate alert routing to initiative owners with suggested mitigations
scope: Delegation rules for error-budget actions up to 72-hour windows
Contingency matrix covering latency, availability, and correctness SLIs
Dashboard templates and alert mappings in Console
Documentation and 1-hour training for initiative leads
out_of_scope: Major platform-wide capacity procurement (handled by infra finance)
Changes to SLI definitions or measurement pipelines (tracked separately)
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Confluence and linked from Initiative Hub
Console dashboard template appears in Initiative view with correct metrics
Alerting rules created that route to initiative owner on-call with suggested mitigations
Two pilot initiatives adopt the delegation model for a 4-week trial
deliverables: Console: initiative dashboard template and alert wiring
Runbook: decision tree for initiative owners (PDF + Slack flow)
milestones: 2026-03-05: Engineering feasibility review and alert spec
2026-03-22: Console dashboard prototype and pilot wiring
open_risks: Teams may interpret thresholds inconsistently — mitigated via training and templated actions
Alert fatigue if suggestions are too noisy — mitigated by tiered routing and suppression windows
Dependencies on metric parity across regions for multi-region initiatives
decisions: Adopt a three-tier delegation model: Observe (inform), Throttle (owner action), Escalate (reliability lead)
Use 7-day rolling burn rate and 90th/95th latency windows for threshold calculations
Pilot will use two non-critical initiatives before wider rollout
